articles.title: Raspberry Sugar Found in Space!
articles.summary: A sugar found in raspberries was discovered near the center of the Milky Way. It hints that life's ingredients are common in space.

articles.title: A Time Capsule for America's 250th Birthday!
articles.summary: A time capsule will be buried in Philadelphia on July 4, 2026, to be opened in 2276. It contains items from all 50 states.

articles.title: Tesla Is Building a Robotaxi for Wheelchair Users!
articles.summary: Tesla says it's building a wheelchair-accessible self-driving car. No robotaxi company currently offers this.
